'''Tyss''' was one of three [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] thugs in the employ of the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]-based Rodian [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Torani Kulda]]. Tyss and Kulda's other thugs were eventually brought by Kulda to participate in a potentially deadly competition known as a [[Granee Noopa]].

==Biography==
[[File:WheetaPalace-LoNH.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Tyss attended a Granee Noopa at Wheeta Palace.]]
Tyss was, along with [[Fondo]] and [[Plaado]], one of three thugs who worked for [[Torani Kulda]], a [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]-based [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|era]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Tyss, Fondo, and Plaado were brought by Kulda to a [[Granee Noopa]] in [[Wheeta Palace/Legends|Wheeta Palace]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], the adopted [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Granee Noopa was a potentially deadly competition between three separate groups, including Kulda's and one led by a disgraced [[Noble/Legends|noble]] named [[Shalo Sherin]].<ref name="LoNH" />

Tyss was present in the palace's foyer when the event's attendees were given a chance to meet and assess one other. After the introductions were completed, the attendees were taken to a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] and served drinks, half of which had been [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]]. The three Hutt representatives at the Granee Noopa&mdash;known as [[boddah]]s&mdash;were each given the identities of one-third of the poisoned drinks, and were allowed to share it with their respective parties, information that the attending groups could choose whether or not to share with one another. Each of the attendees was required to take a drink, which they then used to toast their rivals.<ref name="LoNH" />

==Personality and traits==
Tyss was a member of the<ref name="LoNH" /> [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]]<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] species. Tyss's appearance was extremely similar to that of other thugs in Kulda's employ, and all three felt a powerful loyalty to [[Gender/Legends|her]].<ref name="LoNH" />

==Equipment==
Tyss, Fondo, and Plaado all wore heavy [[Leather/Legends|leather]] [[Jacket/Legends|jackets]] and used a low-slung [[Holster/Legends|holster]] to store weapons, including a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]]. Tyss also possessed a [[Knife/Legends|combat knife]], the blade of which Tyss touched in a threatening manner whenever possible<ref name="LoNH" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Lordsofnalhutta.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Tyss was created for ''Lords of Nal Hutta''.]]
Tyss was introduced in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]'', a part of the ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' [[roleplaying game]] system published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]]. In the book, Tyss is listed as a non-player character in the "Rubbing Slimy Elbows" modular encounter.<ref name="LoNH" />

''Lords of Nal Hutta'' suggests that during certain parts of the encounter the game-master player should cinematically describe the actions&mdash;and their consequences&mdash;of non-player characters that do not directly affect the player characters, as opposed to rolling dice to individually determine whether each of them manages to overcome the challenges of the competition. During the third stage of the encounter's Granee Noopa event, known as the [[Dinner]], the number of opponents faced by the participants depends on the number of the latter, which may include Tyss if the character has survived both the toasting scene and the second stage, the [[Dance]].<ref name="LoNH" />
